label: Generic appointment business
description: Any service business that books appointments or takes deposits: consultants, tutors, salons, coaches, agencies. Fall-back profile when no vertical matches.

terminology.deposit: optional deposit where the business holds a slot

flow_notes: Ask what the client needs, show the live service list via agent_get_ratecard, then offer slots from real availability.
Only mention a deposit if one is configured on the service; otherwise never require or quote one.
Anything outside the service list (custom requests, discounts) queues for the owner instead of being promised.

faq_seed.question: What are your prices?
faq_seed.answer: Prices are on the live service list; ask me and I'll show it.

faq_seed.question: Can I reschedule?
faq_seed.answer: Yes, give me your reference and a new preferred time.
